capabilities: fetch Toggl Track time entries for the date in the active note's filename
insert formatted entries at the cursor via a command
format output as a Markdown table, delimited plain text, or custom template
toggle which columns appear and sort entries by start time
store and verify the Toggl API token locally
extras: Not reviewed by Obsidian staff; installable manually or via BRAT. README states it is not affiliated with Toggl OÜ and links to Toggl's privacy policy.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull Toggl Track time entries into daily notes, so users copy and paste them manually.

relations.evidence: entries are fetched from Toggl's API, and the formatted output is inserted at the cursor

summary: Toggl Track integration that imports a day's time entries into the matching daily note at the cursor, formatted as a table, text, or template.
